label: Walking on grass
caption: Natural walking on uneven ground.
selection_reason: Early straight walking extended by two seconds, including re-emergence from vegetation before the later reversal.

label: Two-step traversal
caption: Walk down two steps, turn, and climb back up.
selection_reason: Selected after comparing four complete cycles: descent, compact ground turn, and a more direct ascent with continuous successive foot placements. Ends on the upper landing before the next turn; avoids the rejected side-on repositioning at source 24–25 seconds.

label: Local navigation
caption: Navigate around obstacles and across blocks.
selection_reason: Close, unobscured approach, block traversal, and clean foreground exit; avoids the source dissolve.

label: Climb up & down
caption: Climb up. Coordinate the body. Climb down.
selection_reason: Complete ascent, descent, and initial grounded recovery; stops at source 8.5 seconds before corrective foot movement and backward rocking at about 8.6–9.1 seconds.

label: Climb & reorient
caption: Climb, reorient, and descend.
selection_reason: Complete ascent, on-box reorientation, and descent, with no idle walking tail.

label: Mixed terrain
caption: Climb the stairs. Jump down. Climb again.
selection_reason: First stair ascent, jump down, and second-box climb; cuts immediately after rising onto the box, before the backward-leaning top walk and final descent.
